2607.00530.title: From Technical Metrics to User Perception: A User Study of a Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction System for Object Detection and Grasping
2607.00530.paper_summary: Improvements in the technical performance of human--robot interaction (HRI) systems do not automatically translate into differences that human users can detect during live interaction. This paper investigates whether a 15 percentage point gain in end-to-end task success (from 75% in a multimodal baseline system to 90% in an improved configuration identified through a prior ablation study) is sufficient to produce consistent and measurable differences in user perception. The baseline system combines Whisper for speech recognition, Florence-2 for open-vocabulary object detection, LLaMA 3.1 for action extraction, and an interval Type-2 fuzzy logic controller for motion execution. The improved configuration replaces the perception and language modules with Grounding DINO + SAM and Qwen 3.5 9B, respectively, while retaining the same controller. A within-subject user study with 24 participants compared both systems on the same tabletop object-grasping task. After interacting with each configuration, participants rated perceived speed, reliability, and overall competence and fluency on a 7-point Likert scale. Results show that 17 out of 24 participants (70.83%) preferred the improved system (exact binomial test, p = 0.043, h = 0.43), and all three perceptual constructs were rated significantly higher for the improved configuration after Holm correction, with large to very large effect sizes (p < 0.001). These findings confirm that the identified technical improvements are perceptible to users in direct interaction and underscore the importance of complementing benchmark evaluation with user-centred evidence when assessing robotic manipulation pipelines.
2607.00530.paper_summary_zh: 人機互動（HRI）系統在技術性能上的改善並不自動轉化為人類用戶在實時互動中能夠察覺的差異。本文探討了在端到端任務成功率上提高15個百分點（從多模態基準系統的75%提高到通過先前消融研究確定的改進配置的90%）是否足以產生用戶感知上的一致且可測量的差異。基準系統結合了Whisper進行語音識別、Florence-2進行開放詞彙物體檢測、LLaMA 3.1進行行為提取，以及一個區間型2模糊邏輯控制器進行運動執行。改進的配置則將感知和語言模塊分別替換為Grounding DINO + SAM和Qwen 3.5 9B，同時保留相同的控制器。一項包含24名參與者的被試內用戶研究比較了這兩個系統在相同的桌面物體抓取任務上的表現。在與每個配置互動後，參與者在7點李克特量表上評價了感知速度、可靠性以及整體能力和流暢性。結果顯示，24名參與者中有17人（70.83%）更喜歡改進的系統（精確二項檢驗，p = 0.043，h = 0.43），並且在Holm修正後，所有三個感知構念在改進配置上的評價顯著更高，效果大小從大到非常大（p < 0.001）。這些發現證實了所識別的技術改進在直接互動中對用戶是可感知的，並強調在評估機器人操作管道時，將基準評估與以用戶為中心的證據相結合的重要性。
